simple.summary: הֲדַסָּה (Hădaççâh) means Hadassah (or Esther) First listed occurrence: Esth 2 7.

definitions.full: H1919. Hadassah הֲדַסָּה proper name, feminine Jewish name of Esther ( = myrtle , on form compare Sta § 199 a ) Est 2:7 (compare אֶסְתֵּר ).
